criteria.id: inspecting a transition lists required fields, evidence, reviews, and approvals and names what is missing
an invalid transition is blocked and the missing items are explained
override requires actor, reason, and scope and writes an audit record while forbidden lifecycle moves stay blocked
planning a WorkItem produces steps with dependencies, roles, skills, tools, checks, and handoffs
starting a plan creates a collaboration task for agent work and does not start blocked or unapproved steps
an approval request declares requester and required approver roles; approve, reject, and revision-request write role-scoped events
dependent steps stay queued until required approvals are resolved
a workflow run shows owner, running and blocked steps, waiting approvals, next action, scheduler reasons, and a timeline
authorized users can pause, resume, cancel, retry, and reassign steps
built-in capabilities and the default template are versioned; builtin definitions cannot be mutated in place and a project selects or clones them
customers cannot manage workflow runs or approvals
